variation: Unassisted bodyweight pistol squat on one working leg with the other leg straight forward and off the floor; same side throughout, then repeat opposite side.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter facing right, both shoes and working-foot heel visible.
equipment: Bodyweight on level floor, no bench or assistance.

beats.label: Balance on one leg
beats.cue: Stand on one leg; extend the other.
beats.pose: Working foot planted flat, nonworking leg straight forward off floor, arms forward for balance.

beats.label: Sit back and down
beats.cue: Bend your standing knee; keep heel planted.
beats.pose: Half-depth single-leg squat, other leg straight and suspended, arms forward.

beats.label: Reach controlled depth
beats.cue: Lower near your heel without losing balance.
beats.pose: Deep controlled squat, hips near working heel, working heel planted, free leg straight forward off floor.

beats.label: Keep your position
beats.cue: Keep free leg lifted and knee aligned.

beats.label: Drive upward
beats.cue: Push through your planted foot to stand.

beats.label: Finish before switching
beats.cue: Stand tall, then repeat the other side.
